name: history_actor
description: A row an engine removes records who removed it in its history: the DELETE image of a row a save unsets names the save's actor, and the DELETE image of a row a sweep collects from a discarded ref names the sweep's actor, not the row's last writer.

steps.statement: INSERT INTO recipe (id, title, created_by) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'Bread', $2::uuid)

SELECT operation, CASE (data->>'updated_by')::uuid WHEN $1::uuid THEN 'Cook' WHEN $2::uuid THEN 'Baker' ELSE data->>'updated_by' END AS actor FROM step_history WHERE (data->>'ref_id')::uuid = $3::uuid ORDER BY _version
UPDATE recipe_ref SET deleted_at = now() - interval '8 days' WHERE id = $1::uuid

SELECT operation, CASE (data->>'updated_by')::uuid WHEN $1::uuid THEN 'Cook' WHEN $2::uuid THEN 'Janitor' ELSE data->>'updated_by' END AS actor FROM step_history WHERE (data->>'ref_id')::uuid = $3::uuid ORDER BY _version
